description: This is a JUnit test class for the BookController in a Java Spring Boot application. It contains unit tests for various endpoints like retrieving all books, finding by ID, updating, deleting, and other functionalities related to BookController.

classes.name: BookControllerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for BookController, testing various endpoints and behaviors using mocks.

methods.name: all_pageNumberIsOptional
methods.description: Tests that calling 'all' with null page parameter invokes the service with null.

methods.name: all_returnsEmptyList_whenNoBooksExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' method returns an empty list when the book service returns no books.

methods.name: all_returnsBadRequest_whenNegativePage
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' method throws a ResponseStatusException with BAD_REQUEST status for negative page numbers.

methods.name: all_returnsNonEmptyList_whenBooksExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' method returns a non-empty list when books are present.

methods.name: findById_returnsBook_ifPresent
methods.description: Tests that 'findById' returns the book when the book exists.

methods.name: findById_returnsNotFound_ifBookIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that 'findById' throws ResponseStatusException when the book is not found.

methods.name: findByShelf_returnsNotFound_ifBookDoesNotExist
methods.description: Pending implementation, intended to test behavior when a book by shelf is not found.

methods.name: update_callsService_ifBookPresent
methods.description: Tests that 'update' calls the service correctly when the book exists.

methods.name: update_throwsNotFoundException_ifBookNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that 'update' throws a ResponseStatusException when the book is not found.

methods.name: getGenres_alwaysReturnsNonEmptyArray
methods.description: Tests that 'getGenres' always returns a non-empty array (assuming it returns a list of genres).

methods.name: delete_returnsNotFound_ifBookDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that 'delete' responds with NOT_FOUND status if the book doesn't exist.

methods.name: delete_returnsOk_ifBookExists
methods.description: Tests that 'delete' responds with OK status when the book exists and is deleted.
